(3) faq/faq-entries.md holds each new or changed FAQ entry as the visitor sees it ('coming' where not built). (4) release.json: {"name","gate","what","files":[...],"decisions":[...],"tests":[...],"risks":[...],"verify":[...],"regions":bool}.
